title: Immutable requests, receipts and reply chains
summary: Requests are immutable. A reply is a new request linked by parentRequestId and rootRequestId. Read state is an append-only per-reader receipt, not a request status mutation.
invariants: Never overwrite a request body to represent a reply.
Never use one global read flag when multiple principals may see a request.
Journal append must succeed before in-memory state is published.
